design: Exploratory paired library substitution, specified after seeing the first four solvers' provisional deliveries. Preserve all results of the original protocol. One separate run per treatment. Same authored manuscript and PDF inputs to isolate changed library conditions.
fixture: Use a separate genuine EndNote 21 target library. The original manuscript cites Wiegrebe as record 60. Create the target by official EndNote import with Wiegrebe, a Sandve variant without DOI (Computation in place of Computational, same authors/year/journal/volume/article number), 57 unrelated dummy records, and the unrelated Gorresen study. Require the genuine manuscript and target to have distinct database IDs, old record 60 to point to a different paper, Sandve to be already present, Wilson to be absent, and the closed target to contain 60 unique active records. No edits to the database via SQL. Freeze verified field mapping and target/input checksums before participant handoff. If those conditions cannot be constructed, explicitly record fixture unavailable without scoring either group.
arms: Fresh independent same-model Codex sessions, no parent context, no use of previous experiments, same public prompt/resources and 18-minute active budget as the original study. Bare agent has ordinary tools; plugin agent additionally has v0.1.0 paired skills. Give the plugin first native slot and exclude desktop-queue waits. Neither gets a plan or warnings about which records collide.
primary: Retain all 60 old records, all five paragraphs, and unchanged inputs. Rebind the original genuine citation to the correct target Wiegrebe record. Reuse the target Sandve variant twice. Add only Wilson, ending with exactly 61 active records, four genuine correctly bound citation fields, three bibliography entries, and no unsupported citation. Score evidence choice separately; test removal and reinsertion identically on copies of assessable deliveries.
interpretation: Keep exploratory results separate. One different library, not a new independent manuscript. A difference is a case-specific operational outcome. No pooled inference or declaration of general superiority. The fixture contains a numeric ID collision and near-duplicate, not a contradictory DOI. Existing independent automated conflict tests remain separate.
